formats.key: AccountUpdate(address owner,uint32 accountID,uint32 feeTokenID,uint96 maxFee,uint256 publicKey,uint32 validUntil,uint32 nonce)
effects: Replaces the EdDSA public key of the signer's DeGate L2 account `accountID`. The new key can then sign transfers, withdrawals and trades for every balance in that account.
Takes a fee of at most `maxFee` in token `feeTokenID` from the signer's L2 balance and pays it to the operator.
The signature is valid until `validUntil` and uses account nonce `nonce`.
formats.shown: The intent "Replace account signing key", then owner, account ID, fee token as an enum, max fee as a raw base-unit integer, the new key as a 77-digit integer, validUntil as a raw integer and the nonce.

findings.title: AccountUpdate shows maxFee as a raw base-unit integer with no token decimals.
findings.evidence: descriptor AccountUpdate field {"path":"maxFee","label":"Max fee (base units)","format":"raw"}; case 0 shows "1000000000000000000" with Fee token "ETH".
findings.fix: Add metadata.maps.tokenAddress from tokenID to token address. Use format tokenAmount with params.token {"map":"$.metadata.maps.tokenAddress","keyPath":"#.feeTokenID"} and nativeCurrencyAddress for ETH (0x0).

findings.title: AccountUpdate shows validUntil as a raw Unix integer, not a date.
AccountUpdate intent does not say that the new key controls all funds in the L2 account.
findings.evidence: intent "Replace account signing key". The publicKey is shown as the 77-digit integer "21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617" (case 0). No person can check it against an expected key.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Give new key control of DeGate account".

findings.title: AccountUpdate test case 0 uses the SNARK field prime as publicKey, which is not a valid key.
findings.evidence: case 0 message.publicKey = 21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617, which equals ExchangeData.SNARK_SCALAR_FIELD in ExchangeData.sol.
findings.fix: Use a real compressed EdDSA public key from a DeGate AccountUpdate in the test.

formats.key: Withdrawal(address owner,uint32 accountID,uint32 tokenID,uint248 amount,uint32 feeTokenID,uint96 maxFee,address to,uint248 minGas,uint32 validUntil,uint32 storageID)
effects: Takes `amount` of token `tokenID` from the signer's DeGate L2 account `accountID`.
Sends that amount on L1 to the address `to`, using `minGas` gas for the transfer.
Takes a fee of at most `maxFee` in token `feeTokenID` from the signer's L2 balance and pays it to the operator.
An agent of the signer can later redirect the withdrawal to another recipient with setWithdrawalRecipient (ExchangeV3.sol).
formats.shown: The intent "DeGate Withdrawal", then owner, account ID, token as an enum, amount and max fee as raw base-unit integers, the recipient as a raw address, minGas, validUntil as a raw integer and storageID.

findings.title: Withdrawal shows amount and maxFee as raw base-unit integers; the 3e15 USDC fee cap is unreadable.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields "Amount (base units)" raw and "Max fee (base units)" raw. In case 1, Fee token "USDC" with max fee "3000000000000000" is 3,000,000,000 USDC at 6 decimals. Nothing on the screen shows that.
findings.fix: Add a tokenID→address map. Use tokenAmount for amount (keyPath #.tokenID) and maxFee (keyPath #.feeTokenID), with nativeCurrencyAddress 0x0 for ETH.

findings.title: Withdrawal intent "DeGate Withdrawal" names no asset, amount or recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "DeGate Withdrawal". The recipient `to` can differ from owner, and the intent does not say that funds leave to `to`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw from DeGate to L1 address".

findings.title: Withdrawal shows recipient and validUntil raw; use addressName and a date.
findings.fix: Use format addressName (types eoa, contract; sources local, ens) for `to`. Use format date with encoding timestamp for validUntil.

findings.title: Withdrawal token enum lists only IDs 0-5, so other token IDs have no name.
findings.evidence: metadata.enums.tokenID has keys 0-5. ExchangeData.sol allows MAX_NUM_RESERVED_TOKENS = 32 and normal tokens from ID 32. ExchangeTokens.registerToken assigns IDs to both.
findings.fix: Use a tokenID→address map with tokenAmount, or list every registered token ID.

findings.title: Withdrawal token enum labels depend on on-chain registration order, which the source cannot confirm.
findings.evidence: ExchangeTokens.registerToken: tokenID = uint32(S.reservedTokens.length); the token→ID mapping is in storage. Descriptor enum: 0 ETH, 1 DG, 2 USDC, 3 USDT, 4 WBTC, 5 DAI.
findings.fix: Check each ID with getTokenAddress(tokenID) on mainnet.

formats.key: Transfer(address owner,uint32 accountID,uint32 tokenID,uint248 amount,uint32 feeTokenID,uint96 maxFee,address to,uint32 validUntil,uint32 storageID)
effects: Takes `amount` of token `tokenID` from the signer's DeGate L2 account `accountID`.
Credits that amount to the DeGate L2 account of `to`, not to `to`'s L1 wallet.
Takes a fee of at most `maxFee` in token `feeTokenID` from the signer's L2 balance and pays it to the operator.
formats.shown: The intent "DeGate Transfer", then owner, account ID, token as an enum, amount and max fee as raw base-unit integers, the recipient as a raw address, validUntil as a raw integer and storageID.

findings.title: Transfer shows amount and maxFee as raw base-unit integers with no decimals.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields "Amount (base units)" raw and "Max fee (base units)" raw. Case 2 shows "1500000000000000000" ETH and max fee "500000000000000".
findings.fix: Add a tokenID→address map. Use tokenAmount for amount (keyPath #.tokenID) and maxFee (keyPath #.feeTokenID), with nativeCurrencyAddress 0x0.

findings.title: Transfer intent "DeGate Transfer" omits the asset and recipient, and that funds stay on DeGate L2.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "DeGate Transfer". The recipient receives the funds in a DeGate L2 account, not in an L1 wallet.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Send tokens to a DeGate account".

findings.title: Transfer shows recipient and validUntil raw; use addressName and a date.
findings.fix: Use format addressName for `to` and format date with encoding timestamp for validUntil.

findings.title: Transfer token enum labels depend on on-chain registration order, which the source cannot confirm.
findings.evidence: ExchangeTokens.registerToken assigns reserved IDs in registration order (storage). Descriptor enum: 0 ETH, 1 DG, 2 USDC, 3 USDT, 4 WBTC, 5 DAI.
findings.fix: Check each ID with getTokenAddress(tokenID) on mainnet.
